old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of two ice cubes placed on a rough, textured surface, likely concrete or stone. The background is softly blurred, revealing an outdoor setting with greenery and what appears to be a building structure in the distance. The ice cubes are melting, with water pooling around them. As time progresses, the ice cubes gradually shrink in size, and the water level rises slightly. The ice cubes' surfaces become increasingly translucent due to the melting process. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on the melting ice cubes and the subtle changes in their appearance and the surrounding water. The overall scene conveys a sense of gradual transformation under the influence of heat.

caption: The video captures a close, static view of two pale blue-white ice pieces resting on a wet, reddish-brown stone ledge. A larger, rounded rectangular block stands tilted upright toward the right, while a smaller, flatter rounded piece lies to its left. A thin sheen of water and glistening reflections surround their bases against a softly blurred background of trees, an open field, and a tall structure. Throughout the excerpt, the upright block melts gradually, its rounded top edge lowering and its height diminishing while its lean and position stay essentially unchanged. The smaller piece likewise loses vertical extent, flattening slightly as it thaws. The water film persists around both bases, spreading only marginally. The framing and relative positions remain constant, with no camera movement and no new objects entering or leaving.
